name: Fredericksburg
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Fredericksburg, VA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Fredericksburg, Virginia for 2026: a VRE Santa Train, the Christmas Parade and Pictures with Santa, with dates and prices.
lede: Fredericksburg brings Christmas downtown with an evening parade, Santa at the Visitor Center and a holiday train ride that leaves from the VRE station.
celebrates: Fredericksburg's holiday season runs through its downtown. The city and Visit Fredericksburg host the Fredericksburg Tree Lighting at Riverfront Park, held November 14 this year with kids' activities and a visit from Santa. The Fredericksburg Christmas Parade follows on Saturday, December 5 at 5:30 pm, and the Visitor Center at 601 Caroline Street hosts Pictures with Santa on five dates. Virginia Railway Express adds its Santa Train from the Fredericksburg station on December 12, with ticket sales online only.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for Fredericksburg's holiday events, so this page sticks to the 2026 schedule from the city, Visit Fredericksburg and VRE.
facts: The Fredericksburg Christmas Parade is a traditional evening parade with floats, marching bands, fire trucks, horses and Santa Claus, according to its own website. Visit Fredericksburg calls the Pictures with Santa program its sixth annual, and the Visitor Center moved to a new building at 601 Caroline Street.
trains: Fredericksburg is a stop on Virginia Railway Express's Fredericksburg line. On Saturday, December 12, 2026, VRE runs Santa Trains with Santa, Mrs. Claus and elves, and the Fredericksburg station at 425 Princess Anne Street has two departures, at 8:30 am and 10 am. Tickets are $10 for every rider and are sold online only starting November 30.
traditions: An evening parade through downtown, free to watch.
Five minutes of one-on-one time at the Visitor Center, $5 per family.
A 75 minute ride with Santa and Mrs. Claus from the Fredericksburg station.
VRE's Fredericksburg station collects unwrapped toys on Santa Train day.
kidfact: The Santa Train carries Santa, Mrs. Claus and elves who hand out candy canes and coloring books, and every rider, even a baby, needs a ticket.
faq: Are there Christmas events for kids in Fredericksburg?
Yes. For 2026 we list the VRE Santa Train on December 12, the Fredericksburg Christmas Parade on December 5 at 5:30 pm and Pictures with Santa at the Visitor Center on five dates in December.
Where does the Fredericksburg Santa Train leave from?
The Fredericksburg VRE Station at 425 Princess Anne Street, with trains at 8:30 am and 10 am on December 12. Tickets are $10 per rider, online only through Eventbrite.
Is the Fredericksburg Christmas Parade free?
Yes. Visit Fredericksburg lists the parade as free admission, with the public invited, on Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 5:30 pm.
How do I get Pictures with Santa tickets in Fredericksburg?
Each date has its own ticket link on the Visit Fredericksburg page. Tickets are $5 plus a processing fee per family or group, and each group gets five minutes with Santa.
